"""
Created on Tue Mar  5 07:01:52 2024

Method EBSI Proposed by Du et al. (2015). “Stress wave tomography,” 
BioResources 10(3), 3948-3962.

Data from Analysis of wave velocity patterns in black cherry trees and its 
effect on internal decay detection

Black cherry trees I (17-50)

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168169914000684


Table 3 shows the measured velocity data for sample 1–50. Fig. 9
illustrates the theoretical velocity model of the black cherry and
the measured velocity data under source point 1, and Fig. 10 shows
the tomogram of sample 1–50.

It can be seen from Table 3 that, from source point 1, the wave
velocities were 999 m/s (1–2), 1150 m/s (1–3), 1199 m/s (1–4),
1184 m/s (1–5), 1044 m/s (1–6), 764 m/s (1–7), 826 m/s (1–8),
1048 m/s (1–9), 1110 m/s (1–10), 1064 m/s (1–11), and 996 m/s
(1–12). From Fig. 9, it can be seen that the line velocities of 1–5,
1–6, 1–7, 1–8, and 1–9 deviated from the theoretical values
dramatically. The largest deviation was the line velocity for 1–7,
which represents the radial direction. 

Consequently, we can speculate that internal decay exists in the central 
area of the cross section, and the decay area is surrounded 
by the lines 1–5 and 1–9, which matches with the tomogram 
of sample 1–50 reasonably well as shown in Fig. 10.

@author: marik
"""

e = 0.9
max_n = 16

def shifted_coordinates(s, epsilon=0.05):
    start = s.start_coordinates
    end = s.end_coordinates
    vect = end-start
    shift = vect/np.linalg.norm(vect)
    shift = np.array([-shift[1],shift[0]])*epsilon
    start = start + shift
    end = end + shift
    return np.array([[start[0],end[0]],[start[1],end[1]]]) 

t = tomo.Tomo (speeds=data_velocity, nx=41, ny=41)

# limits = {"speed_max":1550, "speed_min":500}
limits = {}

# Fix the velocities as described in EBSI
# Du et al. (2015). “Stress wave tomography,” BioResources 10(3), 3948-3962.
# Plot both original and fixed rays.
# fig,ax = plt.subplots()
# t.plot(grid=False, ax=ax, **limits)

# Each ray will be divided at least once
max_length = min([i.length for i in t.rays])*0.5

x = np.linspace(-1.2,1.2,100)
y = np.linspace(-1.2,1.2,100)
xx,yy = np.meshgrid(x,y)

for I in range(4):
    for ray in t.rays:
        for segment in ray.segments.copy():
            if ray.length*(segment.end-segment.start) > max_length and len(ray.segments)<max_n:
                s1,s2 = segment.split()
                allsegments = t.allsegments
                starts = np.array([s.start_coordinates for s in allsegments]).reshape(-1,1,2)
                ends = np.array([s.end_coordinates for s in allsegments]).reshape(-1,1,2)
                points_on_segments = starts + np.linspace(0,1,10).reshape(1,-1,1) * ( ends - starts)
                # for _ in [s1,s2]:
                #     important_segments = _find_segments_through(_,allsegments,points_on_segments)

fig,ax = plt.subplots()
for _ in range(5):
    i = random.randrange(len(allsegments))
    s = allsegments[i]
    # ax.plot(*list(zip(s.start_coordinates,s.end_coordinates)), lw=7)
    
    # Elipsy
    points = np.array([xx.reshape(-1),yy.reshape(-1)]).T
    points = points[tomo.is_point_inside_ellipse(points,
                    s.start_coordinates, s.end_coordinates,
                       eccentricity=e)]
    color = tomo.speed2color(s.speed,max=np.nanmax(data_velocity), min=np.nanmin(data_velocity))
    ax.plot(*points.T,".", alpha=0.15, color=f"C{_}")
    
    # Segmenty skrz
    important_segments = tomo._find_segments_through(s,
                                               np.array(allsegments),
                                               points_on_segments, 
                                               eccentricity=e)
    for seg in important_segments:
        ax.plot(*shifted_coordinates(seg, epsilon=0.005), color=f"C{_}", alpha=0.5)
    ax.text(*(0.5*(s.start_coordinates + s.end_coordinates)), len(important_segments))

ax.set_aspect(1)

fig,ax = plt.subplots()
for r in t.rays:
    ax.plot(*list(zip (r.start.coordinates,r.end.coordinates)), color='k', lw=1)
node = t.nodes[4]

for ray in node.rays_from:
    points = np.array([xx.reshape(-1),yy.reshape(-1)]).T
    e = tomo._e_value_EBSI(ray.start.number, ray.end.number, 12)
    e = 0.76
    for i,s in enumerate(ray.segments):
        points = np.array([xx.reshape(-1),yy.reshape(-1)]).T
        points = points[tomo.is_point_inside_ellipse(points,
                           s.start_coordinates, s.end_coordinates,
                           eccentricity=e)]
        color = tomo.speed2color(s.speed,max=np.nanmax(data_velocity), min=np.nanmin(data_velocity))
        ax.plot(*points.T,".", alpha=0.3, color=color)
        ax.set_aspect(1)
        
        count = 0
        for r in t.rays:
            points = r.start.coordinates + np.linspace(0,1).reshape(-1,1)*(r.end.coordinates - r.start.coordinates)
            if tomo.is_point_inside_ellipse(points, s.start_coordinates, s.end_coordinates, eccentricity=e).any():
                count=count+1
        center_coords = (s.start_coordinates + s.end_coordinates)/2
        plt.text(*center_coords,count)

ax.set(title=f"iteration {I}, node {node.number}")
